examples.arabic: مساء الخير اليوم قررت ان اطبخ طبقا جديدا لأول مرة
examples.english: Good evening, today I decided to cook a new dish for the first time.
examples.transliteration: Masa' al-khayr al-yawm qarartu an atbukha tabaqan jadidan li'awwali marrah.

examples.arabic: قررت سارة ان تطهو طبقا جديدا للمرة الاولى
examples.english: Sarah decided to cook a new dish for the first time.
examples.transliteration: Qarrarat Sarah an taṭhuwa ṭabaqan jadīdan lil-marrah al-ūlá.

examples.arabic: ثم تكلمت مع معلمتها عن الواجب الجديد وكان سهلا هذه المرة
examples.english: Then she spoke with her teacher about the new homework and it was easy this time
examples.transliteration: Thumma takallamat ma'a mu'allimatihā 'ani al-wājibi al-jadeedi wa kāna sahlan hādhihi al-marrah

examples.arabic: ذات مرة سألت ليلى بصوت رقيق لماذا نحافظ على صلة الرحم مع الأقارب البعيدين
examples.english: One time Layla asked in a soft voice why we maintain kinship ties with distant relatives
examples.transliteration: Dhaata marratin sa'alat Laylaa bi-sawatin raqeeqin limaadhaa nuhaafidhu 'ala silat ar-rahim ma'a al-aqaarib al-ba'eedeen

examples.arabic: قررت سارة ان تجرب طبقا جديدا لأول مرة في مطبخ الاسرة
examples.english: Sarah decided to try a new dish for the first time in the family kitchen
examples.transliteration: Qarrarat Sarah an tujarriba ṭabaqan jadīdan li-awwali marrah fī maṭbakhi al-usrah

examples.arabic: بصراحه كنت اشعر ببعض القلق وانا احضر الطبق الجديد لاول مره
examples.english: Honestly, I felt some anxiety as I prepared the new dish for the first time.
examples.transliteration: Bisaraaha kuntu ash'ur bi ba'd al-qalaq wa ana uhaddir al-tabaq al-jadeed li awwal marra
